free_tier.stated: Quoted: 'we will hire up to twelve Sovereign Tech Fellows, either as freelance contractors or as employees at Sovereign Tech Agency GmbH'. Freelance contracts run 'from 3 to 12 months, with flexible weekly working hours from 6 to 32 hours'; employment pays 'EUR 64,000 to EUR 82,000 per year for a full-time position, including 30 days of vacation'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A 6-hour-a-week freelance contract is the only arrangement that pays a person for maintenance time while leaving the rest of the week for a compute workload, and the money arrives as invoice income that can be spent on any accelerator.

notes: This is the cleanest individual lane in the open-source category: no company, no institution, no fundraise, and the counterparty is an agency that hires freelancers. The gap is timing, not eligibility. Open question that would settle it: whether a 2027 call repeats the 2026 shape, which the page does not announce.
